Definition: akin to G2813 and G2928; to cover up (literally or figuratively):--cover, hide.
BiblicalUsage: Kalypto is to cover up — to hide a thing from sight, whether a lamp under a vessel or a multitude of sins under love. Jesus says there is nothing covered that shall not be revealed; no man lights a candle and covers it; and Peter says charity shall cover the multitude of sins.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe covering cuts two ways, and I must know which one I am doing. To cover a lamp is to hide the light, and that is wrong — but to cover a brother's sins with love is to do what Christ did for me, and that is right.
